_comment: Emeria's INTERVENING IF (CR 603.4), negative half: lhc_emeria_seven_plains_front_wins with ONE Plains fewer. After T7's drop there are only six Plains, so T8's upkeep has NO trigger: Ranger-Captain (the graveyard's only creature, and the axis-off front) stays put, no Ballista is tutored, and nothing wins by T8. Before 2026-10-27 this fixture also held Auriok Champion, whose front pick could not win either way -- so it passed with the intervening if broken; with Ranger-Captain alone a broken check returns it and wins, failing expect_no_win.
